reasons: The directive '#FLUX --mem-per-cpu=12G' is invalid. Flux does not have a '--mem-per-cpu' option. Memory should be specified either for the entire job using '--mem=<size>' or on a per-task basis using '--mem-per-task=<size>'.
issues: The job does not explicitly request any CPU resources via `--ntasks` or `--cpus-per-task`. Flux will likely default to allocating a single CPU core. Since the original intent was to allocate 12G of memory *per CPU*, this default behavior would result in the job only receiving 12G of total memory, which may be insufficient and not what the user intended. A specific CPU count (e.g., `--cpus-per-task=N`) should be requested.

The script's execution logic is entirely dependent on a hardcoded, user-specific absolute path (`cd /scratch/users/kriss1/...`). This makes the script non-portable and it will fail if run by any other user or if the directory structure is changed.
